patterns: APPSC asks direct scheme-name recall: 'policy to install borewells for farmers = Jala Kala' (y5494eca26d2), with look-alike name options.

Recent APPSC (2023/2025) adds A-R on PMFBY and issuing department of the Startup Policy (ITE&C, not Industries).
App MCQs are heavier on multi-statement and match items with G.O. numbers and budget figures; PYQs stay single-fact with confusable scheme names.
